Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

CrowdAgent: Multi-Agent Managed Multi-Source Annotation System (ACL-Anthology-2025.emnlp-demos.72-captured-copy) · paper method: Table 1 reports CrowdAgent above the listed baselines on six multimodal classification tasks at fixed human annotation proportions: 5% for MM-IMDb and COV-CTR and 15% for CrisisMMD’s three subtasks and V-SNLI. This compares annotation accuracy under those ratios rather than holding total system cost or all computation equal.

cohort9.claim.crowdagent.fixed-human-ratios

  • Main-table result only; appendix training/model/budget details are not fully examined here, so no exact-cost, universal efficiency or supplier-performance claim is made.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

CrowdAgent: Multi-Agent Managed Multi-Source Annotation System (ACL-Anthology-2025.emnlp-demos.72-captured-copy) · paper method: CrowdAgent mixes a labeled golden set into the annotation dataset for the QA agent’s aggregation/profiling; the source says golden labels are not exposed to annotators or used as in-context examples. Default Bayesian aggregation estimates confusion matrices from that set and marks confidence-threshold convergence.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

CrowdAgent: Multi-Agent Managed Multi-Source Annotation System (ACL-Anthology-2025.emnlp-demos.72-captured-copy) · paper method: The described iterative workflow uses cheap model labels, small-model denoising and then routes low-confidence, diverse cases to humans using Core-Set selection; it stops on budget, round or confidence conditions and flags difficult residual cases for final human verification.

CrowdAgent: Multi-Agent Managed Multi-Source Annotation System (ACL-Anthology-2025.emnlp-demos.72-captured-copy) · paper method: The limitations acknowledge residual errors requiring targeted human verification and dependence on underlying model capability; a confidence-converged output is not thereby established as an error-free dataset.
